title: Settle the review-side design
request: Deferred from #1: the review-side design questions.
problem: The third gate hasn't been used on a real step, and several review questions are open, so reviews can't be designed with confidence yet.
acceptance: Each question below is decided after reviewing at least one real step result.

openQuestions.text: Can reviews of your own agents' work skip the plan (observed-only), or only reviews of other people's changes?
openQuestions.proposal: Only other people's changes. Your own agents always work from a plan, so their reviews are always checked against it.

openQuestions.text: Do reviews of other people's changes need to reach the authors?
openQuestions.proposal: Export findings one way as pull-request comments when the author uses a forge; otherwise they only inform your own merge decision.

openQuestions.text: Where do approvals live once there's a team: here or in pull-request reviews?
openQuestions.proposal: Here, in refs/ldd, as passkey-signed approvals (#3 Q8), with the gate mirrored to the forge as a required check, as docs/team already describes. The forge never becomes the source of truth, so delegated or forge-side approvals can never decide a gate.

openQuestions.text: Should inline review views show only the rows that need a decision?
openQuestions.proposal: Yes: unplanned, missing, breaking, and inferred rows inline, with matched rows counted, and the full table in a page view. That keeps inline cost tied to what needs attention rather than to the size of the change.
